checks.title: Primary heading

checks.title: HTTPS URL
checks.evidence: https://example.com/
checks.recommendation: Serve the public site over HTTPS.

checks.title: Robots indexability indicator
checks.evidence: Meta: not declared; X-Robots-Tag: not observed. This does not establish indexing.
checks.recommendation: Confirm that noindex is intentional.

checks.title: HTTP status
checks.recommendation: Resolve unexpected HTTP errors.

checks.title: Basic security headers
checks.evidence: CSP: absent; nosniff: absent
checks.recommendation: Review security headers; this is not a ranking score.

checks.title: Link text
checks.evidence: 0 links have no visible text; image/ARIA names need manual review.
checks.recommendation: Give links an accessible descriptive name.

checks.title: HTTP link destinations
checks.evidence: 0 HTTP destinations on an HTTPS page. Links alone are not mixed-content subresources.
checks.recommendation: Prefer HTTPS destinations when supported.

checks.title: Image alternatives
checks.evidence: 0 missing alt; 0 empty alt. Empty alt may be intentional for decorative images.
checks.recommendation: Describe meaningful images and explicitly mark decorative images.

checks.title: Image dimension attributes
checks.evidence: 0 images lack width or height attributes; CSS may reserve space.
checks.recommendation: Reserve image space to reduce layout shifts.

checks.title: Structured data JSON
checks.evidence: 0 JSON-LD blocks; 0 have invalid JSON. This is not full schema/rich-results validation.
checks.recommendation: Use accurate schema and validate against the supported schema requirements.

checks.title: Social metadata
checks.evidence: 0 Open Graph/Twitter tags.
checks.recommendation: Supply relevant social title, description and preview metadata.

checks.title: Broken link verification
checks.evidence: Link destinations have not been fetched.
checks.recommendation: Run a separately bounded verification workflow.

checks.title: Image resource size
checks.evidence: Image files have not been downloaded or measured.
checks.recommendation: Run a separately bounded verification workflow.

checks.title: Rendered JavaScript content

checks.recommendation: Run a separately bounded verification workflow.

checks.title: Hreflang reciprocity
checks.evidence: Alternate pages have not been fetched.
checks.recommendation: Run a separately bounded verification workflow.

checks.title: Lab and field performance
checks.evidence: Run the separate PageSpeed tool for available measurements.
checks.recommendation: Run a separately bounded verification workflow.

scores.methodology: Custom diagnostic score, not a Google score or ranking predictor. Pass=1, warning=0.5, critical=0 within tested checks. Not-tested checks are excluded; coverage is reported separately.
